effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Choose 1 of your level 6 Digimon. It may digivolve into a level 6 Digimon card in your hand with a different name that includes the name of the chosen Digimon, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Return 1 Digimon card from your trash to your hand, and add this card to your hand.
